## B — Audience, Driving record, points and alcohol

The audience is first-time, never-licensed applicants for a Michigan operator's license, reading at a plain-English level, plus newcomers and parents of teen drivers who use the same handbook. This section covers the Michigan driving record, the point system, alcohol and drug laws including implied consent and the zero tolerance rule, and driver reexaminations. It teaches how violations reach the record, how many points common offenses carry, how alcohol and drugs affect driving and the law, and when the Secretary of State may reexamine a driver. It assumes no prior driving knowledge and no prerequisites beyond literacy, so wording stays concrete, procedural and free of legal jargon throughout.
